env.mode: free stack with Pro active (all 17 extensions)

f-a11y.1.evidence: Guest fresh load of /community/: the first Tab lands on 'Skip to content' (href #content, visible at top-left); Enter -> hash #content and the next Tab lands on the first link inside #content.

f-a11y.2.evidence: bob on /community/, /community/s/feature-requests/ and the topic page: tabbed 200 stops on the topic page (and 90 on each of the others) and measured the outline after a 190ms settle. Light: 166 stops 2px solid, 29 theme-menu links 1px dotted rgb(21,48,69), 3 other styled rings; the only stop with no ring is the WP admin-bar search INPUT (core, not ours). Dark (Reign toggle, bg rgb(35,38,47)): 0 stops without a ring (194 x 2px solid rgb(151,192,238), 4 x 1px dotted white). Tab order runs admin bar, skip link, header, menu, content top to bottom. Only Reign was walked in this wave.

f-a11y.3.evidence: No button/role=button on the topic page lacks a name (0 unnamed of 519). Verified labels and states: Reign dark toggle 'Dark mode (click to switch to light)' aria-pressed; font-size A/A+/A++ labelled with aria-pressed; Vote up/down aria-pressed; Bookmark aria-pressed; Share aria-expanded; notifications bell 'Notifications' aria-expanded; More options aria-expanded + aria-haspopup=menu; composer Bold, Italic, Code, Code block (aria-pressed), Link, Blockquote (aria-pressed), Upload image, Insert emoji (aria-expanded); with Pro Anonymous Posting on (space 15 allow_anonymous set temporarily) the toggle is a native checkbox named by its label 'Post anonymously'.

f-a11y.4.evidence: Topic editor: role=textbox, aria-multiline, aria-labelledby=jt-post-body-label ('Content'); title input has <label> 'Title'; reply editor role=textbox aria-label 'Reply editor'; poll builder (Pro): getByRole textbox 'Question', 'Option 1', 'Option 2' each resolve (name from the visible placeholder, no aria-label/label element)

f-a11y.5.evidence: Vote cluster is role=group aria-labelledby 'Votes:' + the score element ('Votes: 0'); the Vote up button toggles aria-pressed and its label 'Vote up' <-> 'Remove your upvote' and the score 0 -> 1 -> 0. Reaction chip (Pro): reacted as bob with Love -> chip 'Love ❤️ 1' aria-pressed=true on the live chip and the same name/state on the reloaded server-rendered chip (getByRole button name /Love/ pressed matched). Reaction removed afterwards.

f-a11y.6.evidence: Keyboard Enter on a reply's Report: [role=dialog] aria-modal aria-labelledby 'Why are you reporting this reply?', content is a role=radiogroup labelled by the title, focus lands on the first radio (spam), 14 Tabs stay inside, Escape closes and focus returns to the Report button.

f-a11y.7.evidence: test_moderator: queue buttons Approve / Spam / Reject / Remove / Dismiss each carry aria-describedby naming the target (e.g. 'Evening harbour shots: schedul...' or 'Dark mode for the community on...'); Remove reached with the keyboard opens a real role=dialog aria-modal 'Remove this reply on ...? It moves to trash...' with Cancel/Confirm (no native alert; 0 native dialogs), Escape closes and returns focus to Remove. Close topic / Delete / Pin / Move / Merge are role=menuitem in More options. Accessible NAME is the verb and the target is its description via aria-describedby, as the check at f-a11y.17 describes.

f-a11y.8.evidence: Share dropdown and notification panel open with both Enter and Space (aria-expanded true), focus moves to the first item (Copy link / Mark all read), ArrowDown/ArrowUp move within, Escape closes (aria-expanded false) and focus returns to the trigger.

f-a11y.9.evidence: Scanned every text node in #content on the Announcements listing, the topic page and a space listing: 719 elements in light and 719 in dark (Reign toggle, bg rgb(35,38,47)), 0 below 4.5:1 (3:1 for large). The 'Content hidden because you blocked this user.' line (alice blocked via POST /users/me/blocks, then unblocked) measures 6.32:1 light and 7.78:1 dark; placeholders measure 7.3:1 light and 7.72-8.05:1 dark (title, tags, poll, editor).

f-a11y.10.evidence: Touch context 390x844: of 213 buttons/inputs only the 13px 'Private reply' checkbox is under 40px and its label is 301x65; docSW 390. Root font 200% -> docSW 390, and a 195px-wide viewport (browser zoom 200%) -> docSW 195, no horizontal scroll. Desktop: A++ takes reply text 17px -> 19.2px and the title 25.5 -> 28.8px while the Reign header (17px) and menu (16px) stay put; Default restores.

f-a11y.11.evidence: Form errors pass: the poll builder error 'Question and at least 2 options required.' appears as role=alert + role=status (aria-live polite) and the invalid option input has aria-invalid=true with aria-describedby -> that message; the copy-link toast is role=status. But the Pro badge result 'Badge awarded.' (and 'Badge revoked.' / 'Badge already awarded to this user.') on wp-admin Jetonomy > Badges is a role=dialog aria-modal box with no live region or role=alert, and keyboard focus is NOT moved into it: document.activeElement stays on the Award/Revoke button behind the overlay until the first Tab (first Tab lands on OK; Escape closes). So a screen reader user is not told the badge was awarded. Seen on /wp-admin/admin.php?page=jetonomy-pro-badges as admin. Probably the result alert opens while the previous prompt modal is closing and the focus restore wins. Product bug (a11y); line wording says toast but the surface is a modal.

f-a11y.15.evidence: Created a Camera body profile field and a value for priya as a fixture (removed afterwards). Profile /community/u/priya/: H1, H2 Badges, H2 Profile Details, then sidebar H2s - no skip. Edit Profile: H1, H2 Crop your photo, H2 More about you - no skip. New topic with Add Poll open: H1 New Topic, H2 Poll - no skip.

f-a11y.12.evidence: finn (silenced): /general-discussion/new/ and the topic page render no editor (0 contenteditable) and show the plain text 'Your account is currently silenced and cannot post.' in the page content (in the accessibility tree, not only a coloured banner); POST a reply -> 403 jetonomy_user_silenced.

f-a11y.13.evidence: Topic, profile and space pages each: nav aria-label='Breadcrumb' with the last item <span aria-current=page> (topic title / Bob Martinez / Feature Requests); exactly one h1 and no skipped heading levels.

f-a11y.14.evidence: Site language ar (dir=rtl), bob keyboard only: typed title and body in the New Topic form, Tabbed to Post Topic (6 Tabs) and pressed Enter -> topic created; replied from the keyboard (editor -> Tab to Post Reply -> Enter) -> reply posted; Enter on a reply's Vote up toggled its state (Vote removed message); Enter on Report, ArrowDown to a reason, Tab to Report, Enter -> 'Reported. Thank you.' (test flag deleted afterwards). Controls were focused programmatically in places; their Tab reachability is covered by f-a11y.2.

f-a11y.16.evidence: bob /community/u/bob/edit/#notification-preferences: 21 checkboxes, 21 unique accessible names, each naming type and channel (e.g. 'Reply to my topic Web', 'Reply to my topic Email', '@Mention Web', 'Vote on my topic Email').

f-a11y.17.evidence: test_moderator: topic More options trigger opened with Enter has aria-haspopup=menu, the list is role=menu with role=menuitem children only (Edit, Make Private, Pin to space, Close topic, Move, Merge, Delete), focus lands on Edit, Escape closes (aria-expanded false) and focus returns to the trigger. On /community/mod/ all 8 'Review in queue' links have aria-describedby ids that resolve to the flagged title/excerpt text.
